newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending Wednesday's gains.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending Wednesday's gains.

text.p: Polish shares are expected to extend Wednesday's gains, signalled by stronger buying after price fixing and at continuous trade, but analysts said current rises were an upward correction within a slight downtrend.

They said a good sign was Wednesday's 0.8-percent gain despite the central bank head's statement in a newspaper she would soon raise nominal rates and collect deposits to offset the effects of government flood relief credit.
But analysts said the run-up to September's parliamentary vote and uncertainty regarding flood damage, seen in the billions of dollars, would dampen buying in coming weeks.
They said strong buying after Wednesday's fixing of Optimus suggested it would extend gains although they were surprised by the sudden sharp rise.
